01 / About Aditya Polymers

A Pune
adhesives story.

Aditya Polymers works with adhesive requirements across paper conversion, packaging and wood working. Its product range is presented under the Dr. Bond name.

Company profile
Based in
Pune, Maharashtra
Product range
Synthetic adhesives and starch based gums
Product brand

02 / Products

A focused industrial range.

From material to finished product.

The company works on adhesive requirements for packaging, paper conversion and wood working.

Its range spans paper conversion, lamination, labeling, starch based gums and furniture adhesives. A useful discussion starts with the materials being joined, how the adhesive is applied and the result the finished product needs to achieve.

03 / Pune divisions

Two material pathways.

Chikhli / PCMC

Synthetic adhesive division

The Chikhli division focuses on synthetic adhesives.

View synthetic adhesive family
Chakan / Pune

Starch gum division

The Chakan division focuses on starch based gums.

View starch based gum family

04 / How we work

A conversation grounded in the work.

Product fit depends on the materials, method and conditions involved.

01 / Understand

Describe the materials

Share the substrates, coatings and end use so the requirement has a clear starting point.

02 / Discuss

Compare product routes

Talk through the application method and whether a synthetic, starch based or wood working product family is relevant.

03 / Evaluate

Review how it performs

Where appropriate, discuss a sample or line trial and use the observations to guide the next product conversation.

Production

Discuss the process.

Share application equipment and line conditions. The team can confirm which product route and production capabilities are relevant.

Testing

Ask what can be checked.

Available checks depend on the product and use. Ask which measures or sample evaluations could help assess fit.

Development

Explain what needs to change.

If existing options do not fit, describe the requirement. The team can confirm whether further development is within scope.

Product fit and evaluation steps depend on the specific requirement. Contact the team to discuss what is available.
